body.name: published rank-two count certificate
body.construction: Using the rank-two deterministic count criterion of Pimentel--Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak and the \( (1,2)\)-sparsity formulation of Streinu and Theran, set \(\operatorname{CSC}_2(H_3)=\{F\subseteq E(H_3):|F'|\le|V(F')|-2\text{ for every }\varnothing\ne F'\subseteq F\}\); accept exactly when a maximum member has \(T-2\) edges and spans \([T]\). The published pebble algorithms decide acceptance and extract a maximum member and tight components in \(O(Tm)\) operations and \(O(T+m)\) storage.
